meta.name: linkedin-storytelling
meta.description: Structure LinkedIn post bodies using proven storytelling frameworks. Use when the user asks about post structure, AIDA, PAS, BAB, storytelling, narrative posts, Mistake-to-Lesson posts, contrarian takes, or LinkedIn copywriting. Do NOT use for hooks/first lines (use hooks) or call-to-action endings (use cta).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 套用经典框架写出更吸引人的LinkedIn帖子正文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要提升LinkedIn帖子的叙述力和转化力
copy.tagline_en: Structure LinkedIn post bodies with proven storytelling frameworks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to craft engaging LinkedIn posts using narrative formulas

howto.what: 它会根据你输入的要求，使用AIDA、PAS、BAB、Mistake→Lesson、Contrarian Take等故事框架组织LinkedIn帖子正文，确保每个帖子只讲一个主题，段落简短，并遵循特定语气和格式规则。
howto.when: 当你询问如何构建LinkedIn帖子、使用特定故事框架（如AIDA、PAS等）或需要叙事性内容（如Mistake-to-Lesson、Contrarian Take）时触发。不用于hook或CTA。

say.text: 用AIDA框架给我写一个产品发布的LinkedIn帖子正文。
帮我写一个“错误到教训”风格的创始人故事帖子。
say.note: 会生成包含Hook、经过、代价、教训、感恩、CTA的故事。

say.text: 用PAS框架组织这段内容：用户发帖没流量。

howto.what_en: It structures LinkedIn post bodies using proven storytelling frameworks such as AIDA, PAS, BAB, Mistake→Lesson, and Contrarian Take. It ensures one idea per post, short sentences, and clear formatting with line breaks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about post structure, specific frameworks (AIDA, PAS, BAB), storytelling, narrative posts, Mistake-to-Lesson, contrarian takes, or LinkedIn copywriting. Not for hooks or CTAs.

say_en.text: Write a LinkedIn post body for a product launch using the AIDA framework.
say_en.note: Produces a post with Attention-Interest-Desire-Action structure.

say_en.text: Create a 'Mistake to Lesson' style post about a founder story.
say_en.note: Generates a narrative with Hook, what happened, cost, lesson, gratitude, CTA.

say_en.text: Use the PAS framework to organize this: user gets low engagement on posts.
